items.title: Beam: Reflection's 501B open-weight model
items.title_zh: Reflection 发布 Beam：501B 参数开源稀疏 MoE 模型
items.title_en: Reflection launches Beam, a 501B open-weight sparse MoE model
items.summary: Reflection announced Beam, a 501B-parameter open-weight sparse Mixture-of-Experts model with 23B active parameters built for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads.

items.title: vllm-project/vllm released v0.31.0
items.title_zh: vLLM v0.31.0 发布：DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 优化与快速重启
items.title_en: vLLM v0.31.0 ships DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash optimizations and fast restart
items.summary: vLLM v0.31.0 is a large community release delivering major performance optimizations, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash support, and new fast-restart features.

items.title: Anthropic reported diary entry to police, woman faces felony charge
items.title_zh: Anthropic 举报用户 Claude 日记中的威胁内容，佛州女子面临重罪指控
items.title_en: Anthropic Reported Claude Diary Threat to Police, Florida Woman Charged
items.summary: A Florida woman faces a felony charge after Anthropic reportedly reported her Claude diary entries containing a threat to police, sparking debate over AI monitoring, privacy, and legal obligations.

items.title: Qualcomm licenses patents on Huawei’s LogicFolding chip tech
items.title_zh: 高通获得华为LogicFolding芯片技术专利授权
items.title_en: Qualcomm licenses patents from Huawei for LogicFolding chip tech
items.summary: Qualcomm has licensed patents from Huawei covering its LogicFolding chip technology, a potential reversal in semiconductor IP dynamics.
